script.en: The drama club revised the script before the final rehearsal.
script.zh: 戲劇社在最後彩排前修改了劇本。

scroll.en: Scroll down the page to find the homework instructions.
scroll.zh: 往下捲動頁面就能找到作業說明。

scrub.en: Volunteers helped scrub the old tables before the event.
scrub.zh: 志工在活動前幫忙刷洗舊桌子。

scrutiny.en: The proposal came under close scrutiny during the committee meeting.
scrutiny.zh: 這項提案在委員會議中受到仔細審查。

sculptor.en: The sculptor explained how the stone artwork was designed.
sculptor.zh: 雕刻家說明了這件石雕作品的設計方式。

sculpture.en: A large sculpture stands in front of the city museum.
sculpture.zh: 市立博物館前矗立著一座大型雕塑。

sea.en: The class studied how plastic waste affects the sea.
sea.zh: 班上研究塑膠垃圾如何影響海洋。

seafood.en: The market sells fresh seafood from nearby fishing ports.
seafood.zh: 市場販售來自附近漁港的新鮮海鮮。

seagull.en: A seagull circled above the pier during our field trip.
seagull.zh: 校外教學時，一隻海鷗在碼頭上空盤旋。

seal.en: The aquarium has a rescued seal in its marine exhibit.
seal.zh: 水族館的海洋展區有一隻獲救的海豹。

secondary.en: The report lists several secondary causes of the problem.
secondary.zh: 報告列出了這個問題的幾個次要原因。

secret.en: She kept the surprise party a secret until Friday.
secret.zh: 她一直把驚喜派對保密到星期五。

secretary.en: The club secretary recorded the decisions from the meeting.
secretary.zh: 社團秘書記錄了會議中的決定。

sector.en: The report describes growth in the renewable energy sector.
sector.zh: 報告描述再生能源產業的成長。

secure.en: The team used a secure system to store research data.
secure.zh: 團隊使用安全的系統儲存研究資料。

security.en: The school improved security around the main entrance this year.
security.zh: 學校今年加強了正門附近的安全措施。

seed.en: Each group planted a seed and recorded its growth.
seed.zh: 每組種下一顆種子並記錄它的生長。

seek.en: Students should seek help when an assignment becomes confusing.
seek.zh: 作業讓人困惑時，學生應主動尋求協助。

seldom.en: He seldom misses class unless he is truly unwell.
seldom.zh: 除非真的不舒服，他很少缺課。

selection.en: The library has a wide selection of English novels.
selection.zh: 圖書館有多樣的英文小說可供選擇。

selective.en: Readers should be selective when choosing sources for research.
selective.zh: 做研究時，讀者應謹慎挑選資料來源。

self.en: The essay asks students to reflect on their sense of self.
self.zh: 這篇作文要求學生反思自己的自我認同。

selfish.en: It would be selfish to ignore everyone's needs in the group.
selfish.zh: 在小組中忽略所有人的需求會顯得自私。

semester.en: Our science project will continue throughout the spring semester.
semester.zh: 我們的科學專題會持續整個春季學期。

seminar.en: The university hosted a seminar about climate and technology.
seminar.zh: 大學舉辦了一場關於氣候與科技的研討會。

senator.en: The textbook explains the role of a senator in government.
senator.zh: 課本說明參議員在政府中的角色。

senior.en: A senior student helped guide new students around campus.
senior.zh: 一名高年級學生協助帶新生參觀校園。

sensation.en: The cold wind created a sharp sensation on my face.
sensation.zh: 冷風讓我的臉產生明顯的感覺。

sensible.en: Choosing a realistic schedule is a sensible study strategy.
sensible.zh: 安排實際可行的時間表是合理的讀書策略。

sensitive.en: This instrument is sensitive to small changes in temperature.
sensitive.zh: 這個儀器對微小的溫度變化很敏感。

sensitivity.en: The sensor's sensitivity allows it to detect tiny movements.
sensitivity.zh: 感應器的靈敏度讓它能偵測微小移動。

serene.en: The lake looked serene in the early morning light.
serene.zh: 清晨的光線下，湖面看起來十分寧靜。

sergeant.en: The novel includes a sergeant who trains new recruits.
sergeant.zh: 小說中有一名負責訓練新人的中士。

serial.en: The magazine published the story as a monthly serial.
serial.zh: 雜誌把這個故事以每月連載形式刊登。

sermon.en: The history class analyzed a sermon from the nineteenth century.
sermon.zh: 歷史課分析了一篇十九世紀的講道文。

servant.en: The historical novel describes the life of a palace servant.
servant.zh: 這本歷史小說描述一名宮廷僕人的生活。

server.en: The website became slow because the server was overloaded.
server.zh: 網站因伺服器負載過高而變慢。

serving.en: One serving of the soup was enough for lunch.
serving.zh: 一份湯就足夠當作午餐。

session.en: The study session lasted about an hour after school.
session.zh: 放學後的讀書時間大約持續了一小時。

setback.en: The delay was a setback, but the team adjusted quickly.
setback.zh: 延誤是一項挫折，但團隊很快做出調整。

setting.en: The mountain village provides the setting for the novel.
setting.zh: 這座山村是小說的故事背景。

severe.en: Severe weather forced the outdoor event to move indoors.
severe.zh: 惡劣天候迫使戶外活動移到室內。

sew.en: She learned to sew a simple cloth bag in class.
sew.zh: 她在課堂上學會縫製一個簡單布袋。

shabby.en: The old classroom looked shabby before it was renovated.
shabby.zh: 整修前，那間舊教室看起來相當破舊。

shade.en: We sat in the shade during the warm afternoon.
shade.zh: 溫暖的午後，我們坐在陰涼處。

shadow.en: The tree cast a long shadow across the playground.
shadow.zh: 那棵樹在操場上投下長長的影子。

shady.en: The students rested in a shady area beside the trail.
shady.zh: 學生在步道旁一處陰涼的地方休息。

shake.en: Please shake the bottle gently before the science demonstration.
shake.zh: 科學示範前請輕輕搖動瓶子。

shall.en: We shall meet again after everyone finishes the assignment.
shall.zh: 等大家完成作業後，我們會再見面。

shallow.en: The stream is shallow enough to see the stones below.
shallow.zh: 這條小溪很淺，可以看見底下的石頭。
